preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership) to call mint() function
Attacker needs some initial token balance to perform burn operation

exploit_hint: The vulnerability lies in incorrect value conversion between reflection (r) and token (t) amounts. The mint() function adds raw amount to _tTotal and _rOwned without proper conversion using the current rate. As owner, call mint() with a large amount to inflate token supply disproportionately, then transfer tokens to other addresses. Alternatively, exploit the burn() function which uses _rOwned values incorrectly. First ensure ownership, then use mint() to create tokens out of thin air.
